CASE 02 // FILE A
THE TROPHY THAT CAME BACK TOO EARLY
That morning, Mimi crosses Trophy Hall with
coffee in one hand and the other buried in her
bag, looking for the phone she was holding five
minutes ago. She notices the Founders' Cup is
missing from its display case. That part is
normal. Max signed it out for a Hall
demonstration. A few hours later, Dilo passes the

polished, centered and apparently having a much
more organized day than the rest of them. Mimi
stops. "Back?" Bibi checks the return sheet.

return tag stamped with one plain 0 - the
same mark printed on the black envelope

handoff.

CASE 06 // FILE A
THE DRAGON TOOTH THAT
WAS ACTUALLY A SPOON
The next morning, Luli goes back to the Look-Twice mismatch list.
Difference #1 is still bothering her: 017 / 071.
This time she checks the Academy records index.
017 is the current Trophy Hall reference.
071 is older. Its archive entry is linked to the retired intake collection kept in Heritage.
It was not a typo.
Photo B came from a different file.
Bibi takes the 071 reference to the Academy Heritage Gallery and goes looking for the older
intake trail.
She gets three steps through the door before Uma, the registrar, intercepts her.
"Good," Uma says. "You're here. I have a dragon problem."
The display label reads CEREMONIAL DRAGON TOOTH.
The object underneath is a perfectly ordinary Roman spoon.
Uma can prove where she was during the relevant window. What she cannot prove is whether
the object moved or the label did.
The map gives her one person to ask first - the person who shared that room and may
remember what was under the label before the mismatch was noticed.
